provenance: GSM8K, PaLM-540B. Endpoints verbatim from Wang et al. 2022 'Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning': single-chain CoT 56.5% -> self-consistency 74.4% (+17.9 pts). Intermediate points interpolated along the published concave (diminishing-returns) shape; the Monte Carlo two-population model reproduces the same endpoints. Other reported absolute gains (not plotted here): SVAMP +11.0, AQuA +12.2, StrategyQA +6.4, ARC-challenge +3.9.
